info.name: Kintsugi API - Stripe Payments Validation
info.description:
Postman suite for EI-1233 covering tax estimation, transaction creation, and GET transaction.

Source: https://trykintsugi.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/IE/pages/2685927478/EI-1233+Postman+Test+Suite+Documentation

Adapted from the Confluence placeholders to the live Kintsugi API:
- Tax: POST /v1/tax/estimate (not /v1/transactions/tax)
- Amounts are major currency units (dollars), not cents
- Auth headers: X-API-KEY + x-organization-id
- Create transaction returns 202; status uses COMMITTED
- Errors are in `detail` (string or validation array), not `error`
- Refund coverage uses a FULLY_REFUNDED sale with negative amounts (credit-notes endpoint currently 404s for this flow)
